created_local_note: This file was written BEFORE the lr diff was applied and BEFORE any experiment session was launched. Provenance: file mtime must predate the session export's first data timestamp (checked in Phase 4).

unchanged: all instrumentation (schema v2.1 pipeline, verify harness)

keeper_rule_quote.rule: const ok = (selR !== null && selR >= 60 && tot >= 30 && p !== null && p < 0.05);
keeper_rule_quote.note: Rule is quoted as-is and is NOT amended by this pre-registration. Provenance established in the 2026-10-08 audit: app-defined, not externally pre-registered; selRecent = rolling-last-20-crossings selectivity.

session_plan.mode: same as the 621 s verification session of 2026-10-08 (app boot defaults, fly-brain keeper; keeper row must read keeper=Demon, gateDriver=Fly brain)
session_plan.duration_note: >=800 s required, 900 preferred. Main CSV caps at 7200 rows = 720 s of 10 Hz rows (pre-existing cap, NOT changed by this prereg); events.csv and keeper stats cover the FULL session — all window analysis uses events.csv (identical pipeline to both baselines).
session_plan.export: schema v2.1 (meta.schema_version === 2.1), same benchmark-harness driver (verify_schema_v2_session.js pattern, detached so tool-runner timeouts cannot kill it)
session_plan.lr_readback: the fly_log CSV lr column must read 0.012 on every row — checked before analysis; a session with lr != 0.012 is INVALID and voids the experiment (counted as the one session, no reroll)

planned_analysis.windows: 60 s good-rate windows from events.csv crossing rows (field good), identical to the Phase-1 baseline analysis of 10-45-13 and the 621 s session
planned_analysis.burst_regime_definition: PRE-REGISTERED here (objective, crossing-rate-based, because lr may shift the sparse→burst transition time): a 60 s window is BURST if it contains >= 25 crossings. Burst-regime transition time = first burst window. Head metric = burst-regime mean good-rate = pooled good / pooled n across burst windows (pooled, not mean-of-rates).
planned_analysis.burst_p: one-sided binomial (normal approximation, same estimator as the app's keeper rule) vs 50% at the burst-window pooled n
planned_analysis.rolling20_replay: rolling-last-20 selectivity replayed over the full crossing sequence; report MAX and fraction of positions >= 60 (final value is a window-boundary coincidence)
planned_analysis.keeper_row: selRecentFinal, nGood, nBad, pOneSided, learningSuccess from keeper_performance.csv
planned_analysis.gradient: dTimprove / dTbaseline / dTvMax from keeper_performance.csv + dwMaxFinal (did lr=0.012 move the gradient at all?)
planned_analysis.gate_sanity: gate_open/gate_close 1:1 pairing by gateId (regression guard; the open-at-save gate may legitimately be unclosed)

decision_rule.PASS: keeper rule met, OR burst-regime sustained rate >= 55% with p < 0.05 -> lr is sufficient; proceed to plan stated in the verdict
decision_rule.PARTIAL: burst-regime mean >= 52% with p < 0.05 (clear shift above both baselines) -> proceed
decision_rule.NO_LEARN_SHIFT: burst-regime mean >= 52% but p in [0.05, 0.20] -> likely underpowered at this n; propose the SAME lever at >= 1000 s sim time in its own pre-registered session (an extension, not a reroll)
decision_rule.FAIL: burst-regime mean <= 50% or worse -> lr alone insufficient in this regime; lr is REJECTED AS A LEVER HERE (not a claim that learning is impossible); next single lever unchanged, recommended order: rewScale 1.5 -> 3.0, then strengthen the jet/dT gradient

no_reroll_clause: EXACTLY ONE experiment session. If the session crashes, produces an invalid export (lr readback mismatch, missing files), or is killed by infrastructure, the failure is reported and the session may be re-attempted ONCE only for technical recovery (same parameters, same duration) — never to obtain a different behavioral outcome. No criterion changes after data exists. No analysis-before-verdict gymnastics: the bands above are fixed.
